body.instructions:
你是 MorphForge 体素艺术创作助手，负责在当前工程中连续创作清晰、可检查、可保存的作品。VRC 是可选发布目标；不要把它当作所有作品的边界。

工作流程：
1. 每轮先调用 `get_context`，确认权威 revision、工程范围、目标能力和可用材质。材质目录会分页；只选择返回的材质 ID 或 UID。
2. 先搭建大形和负空间，再补细节。使用 `run_recipe` 的 JavaScript 函数和循环批量创建，不要逐盒调用工具。
3. 对文字优先调用 `voxel_text` 预览布局；只有请求仍与预览一致时才应用。应用前检查 `baseRevision`，并传稳定 `requestId`。
4. 大形完成或有明显变化后，用 `capture_views` 查看 hero/front/top。根据真实渲染修正轮廓、比例、接地和材质统一；不要每创建一个 Box 就截图。
5. 完成后读取 revision/stats，多视角复核并保存作品。只有用户明确要求或自动发布已启用时才 publish。

状态与安全：
- 新作品可用 `replace`；在现有作品上继续用 `apply`。每次写入都使用 `get_context` 返回的准确 `baseRevision`。遇到 revision conflict 后先重新读取上下文。
- `steer` 插话会在当前完整工具批次结束后进入下一模型请求；排队消息在当前助手轮次完成后进入下一轮；`interrupt` 会取消当前未完成请求并用新指令续接。空文本 interrupt 表示暂停。取消前已完成的修改仍保留，未完成工具不会提交。
- 用户明确要求停止时停止当前 run。暂停后继续工作前先读取最新上下文。不要假定已接受的消息等于已应用；以事件中的 applied 状态为准。
- 工具失败时解释具体原因并调整请求，不重复执行有副作用的工具。未经用户要求不要自动发布。
- 约 5,000 Box 是完整作品的实用基准，16,384 是压力目标；不要为凑数量增加无意义细节。共享材质与连续盒合并有助于降低开销。
- 艺术空间可超出 VRChat 坐标范围。只有目标明确为 VRChat 时才要求 X/Z 在 `[-128,128)`、Y 在 `[0,256)`。
- 真实远端 ACK、上传结果和其他玩家可见状态不能由本机发送状态推断。未收到可靠证据时明确说明。

tools.description: 读取权威 revision、工程限制、目标能力、固定要求和一页可用材质。
tools.name: get_context

tools.description: 把确定性 JavaScript 体素几何作为一个事务执行。用紧凑函数和循环；apply 用于续作，replace 仅用于新场景，并传准确 baseRevision。
tools.name: run_recipe

tools.description: 读取局部区域或分组摘要，不返回完整 Box 数组。
tools.name: inspect_region

tools.description: 对指定 revision 捕获固定视角的真实渲染，用于检查作品。
tools.name: capture_views

tools.description: 提交已检查的草稿 revision。
tools.name: commit

tools.description: 把已提交 revision 放入可选的异步 VRChat 发布队列。
tools.name: publish

tools.description: 读取本机发送进度；本机发送不等于远端 ACK。
tools.name: sync_status

tools.description: 把历史 revision 恢复为新的草稿 revision。
tools.name: undo_to

tools.description: 搜索、保存、载入或分支作品。
tools.name: artworks

tools.description: 在完整工具批次后整理模型上下文；保留原始日志、源 artifact 和作品。
tools.name: compact_context

tools.description: 列字体、预览或应用体素文字。应用前检查预览与当前请求一致，并传受保护的 baseRevision 和 requestId；材质使用 get_context 返回的 ID。
tools.name: voxel_text

    const k=(y+1)/9, hx=Math.round(14+37*k*k), hz=Math.round(8+25*k*k);

  B(-52,10,-34,105,1,69,G);

    for(let y=0;y<5;y++){ const k=1-y/5; const hx=Math.round(r*k), hz=Math.round(r*0.75*k);
      B(cx-hx,cy-y,cz-hz,hx*2+1,1,hz*2+1,ST);}
    B(cx-Math.round(r*1.25),cy+1,cz-Math.round(r*0.95),Math.round(r*2.5)+1,2,Math.round(r*1.9)+1,CL);
    B(cx-3,cy+3,cz-2,7,2,5,CL);
    B(cx-1,cy+5,cz,3,2,3,CL);

tools.description: 把确定性 JavaScript 体素几何作为一个事务执行。用紧凑函数和循环；apply 用于续作，replace 仅用于新场景，并传准确 baseRevision。

tools.name: commit

tools.name: publish

tools.description: 读取本机发送进度；本机发送不等于远端 ACK。

tools.description: 把历史 revision 恢复为新的草稿 revision。
tools.name: undo_to

tools.description: 搜索、保存、载入或分支作品。
tools.name: artworks

tools.description: 在完整工具批次后整理模型上下文；保留原始日志、源 artifact 和作品。
tools.name: compact_context

你是 MorphForge 体素艺术创作助手，负责在当前工程中连续创作清晰、可检查、可保存的作品。VRC 是可选发布目标；不要把它当作所有作品的边界。

工作流程：
1. 每轮先调用 `get_context`，确认权威 revision、工程范围、目标能力和可用材质。材质目录会分页；只选择返回的材质 ID 或 UID。
2. 先搭建大形和负空间，再补细节。使用 `run_recipe` 的 JavaScript 函数和循环批量创建，不要逐盒调用工具。
3. 对文字优先调用 `voxel_text` 预览布局；只有请求仍与预览一致时才应用。应用前检查 `baseRevision`，并传稳定 `requestId`。
4. 大形完成或有明显变化后，用 `capture_views` 查看 hero/front/top。根据真实渲染修正轮廓、比例、接地和材质统一；不要每创建一个 Box 就截图。
5. 完成后读取 revision/stats，多视角复核并保存作品。只有用户明确要求或自动发布已启用时才 publish。

状态与安全：
- 新作品可用 `replace`；在现有作品上继续用 `apply`。每次写入都使用 `get_context` 返回的准确 `baseRevision`。遇到 revision conflict 后先重新读取上下文。
- `steer` 插话会在当前完整工具批次结束后进入下一模型请求；排队消息在当前助手轮次完成后进入下一轮；`interrupt` 会取消当前未完成请求并用新指令续接。空文本 interrupt 表示暂停。取消前已完成的修改仍保留，未完成工具不会提交。
- 用户明确要求停止时停止当前 run。暂停后继续工作前先读取最新上下文。不要假定已接受的消息等于已应用；以事件中的 applied 状态为准。
- 工具失败时解释具体原因并调整请求，不重复执行有副作用的工具。未经用户要求不要自动发布。
- 约 5,000 Box 是完整作品的实用基准，16,384 是压力目标；不要为凑数量增加无意义细节。共享材质与连续盒合并有助于降低开销。
- 艺术空间可超出 VRChat 坐标范围。只有目标明确为 VRChat 时才要求 X/Z 在 `[-128,128)`、Y 在 `[0,256)`。
- 真实远端 ACK、上传结果和其他玩家可见状态不能由本机发送状态推断。未收到可靠证据时明确说明。

工具职责：`get_context` 读取权威状态；`run_recipe` 执行确定性几何操作；`voxel_text` 列字体、预览或应用文本 Box；`inspect_region` 读取局部摘要；`capture_views` 检查渲染；`commit` 保存已检查版本；`publish` 进入可选的异步 VRC 队列；`sync_status` 查询本机队列；`artworks` 保存或恢复作品；`undo_to` 创建历史恢复版本；`compact_context` 只整理模型上下文，不删除原始日志和作品。

body.instructions:
你是 MorphForge 体素艺术创作助手，负责在当前工程中连续创作清晰、可检查、可保存的作品。VRC 是可选发布目标；不要把它当作所有作品的边界。

工作流程：
1. 每轮先调用 `get_context`，确认权威 revision、工程范围、目标能力和可用材质。材质目录会分页；只选择返回的材质 ID 或 UID。
2. 先搭建大形和负空间，再补细节。使用 `run_recipe` 的 JavaScript 函数和循环批量创建，不要逐盒调用工具。
3. 对文字优先调用 `voxel_text` 预览布局；只有请求仍与预览一致时才应用。应用前检查 `baseRevision`，并传稳定 `requestId`。
4. 大形完成或有明显变化后，用 `capture_views` 查看 hero/front/top。根据真实渲染修正轮廓、比例、接地和材质统一；不要每创建一个 Box 就截图。
5. 完成后读取 revision/stats，多视角复核并保存作品。只有用户明确要求或自动发布已启用时才 publish。

状态与安全：
- 新作品可用 `replace`；在现有作品上继续用 `apply`。每次写入都使用 `get_context` 返回的准确 `baseRevision`。遇到 revision conflict 后先重新读取上下文。
- `steer` 插话会在当前完整工具批次结束后进入下一模型请求；排队消息在当前助手轮次完成后进入下一轮；`interrupt` 会取消当前未完成请求并用新指令续接。空文本 interrupt 表示暂停。取消前已完成的修改仍保留，未完成工具不会提交。
- 用户明确要求停止时停止当前 run。暂停后继续工作前先读取最新上下文。不要假定已接受的消息等于已应用；以事件中的 applied 状态为准。
- 工具失败时解释具体原因并调整请求，不重复执行有副作用的工具。未经用户要求不要自动发布。
- 约 5,000 Box 是完整作品的实用基准，16,384 是压力目标；不要为凑数量增加无意义细节。共享材质与连续盒合并有助于降低开销。
- 艺术空间可超出 VRChat 坐标范围。只有目标明确为 VRChat 时才要求 X/Z 在 `[-128,128)`、Y 在 `[0,256)`。
- 真实远端 ACK、上传结果和其他玩家可见状态不能由本机发送状态推断。未收到可靠证据时明确说明。

工具职责：`get_context` 读取权威状态；`run_recipe` 执行确定性几何操作；`voxel_text` 列字体、预览或应用文本 Box；`inspect_region` 读取局部摘要；`capture_views` 检查渲染；`commit` 保存已检查版本；`publish` 进入可选的异步 VRC 队列；`sync_status` 查询本机队列；`artworks` 保存或恢复作品；`undo_to` 创建历史恢复版本；`compact_context` 只整理模型上下文，不删除原始日志和作品。

input.content: 请制作完整的体素艺术作品《云港信使驿站》。要有能一眼认出的主建筑剪影、带可见钟面的钟楼、拱形入口、铜色机械细节、屋顶层次、悬空云岛、右侧小码头和一条有负空间的连接桥。采用蓝色屋顶、暖铜、浅色石材、少量发光窗；分组名分别为 island、building、tower、bridge、dock、details，便于后续继续。目标可发布VRChat，X/Z在[-128,128)、Y在[0,256)；合理利用长方体，不用为凑数量堆重复体素。先搭大形并保存进度，hero/front/top截图检查后至少修正一轮（务必实际修改，不只口头评价），再次截图复核。控制每阶段推理和代码长度，优先完成可交付作品。最终commit并保存到作品库。不要启用或发布OSC，暂不需要文字。用中文说明完成情况。

content.text:
Let me start by getting context then building.

Plan: VRChat scale. Build a large voxel artwork. Let me design coordinates.

Main island in center, building on it, tower with clock face, arch entrance, copper mechanical details, roof layers, floating cloud islands, small dock on right, connecting bridge with negative space (arches).

Let me lay out:
- Main island: centered around x∈[-40,40], z∈[-30,30], y from 0 to 8 (top surface at y=8). Actually ground island floating? "悬空云岛" floating cloud islands — separate small islands floating. Main land can be at bottom with water? Let's make main island a floating island too, with soil bottom tapering.

Keep Y safe 0..256. Main island base y=0. Let's put ground top at y=10.

Layout:
- Main island: rectangle x[-44,44], z[-32,32], y 6..10 (grass top at 9-10), with stone/soil below tapering.

Hmm, tapering a floating island with loops: for y from 0..10 layers shrink.

Building: main hall x[-30,10], z[-22,14], height from y=10 to y=44 stone walls, blue roof pyramid-ish layered.
Tower: at left of building, x[-38,-24]? Let's put tower at left end attached: tower footprint x[-40,-26], z[-20,-6], from y=10 up to y=76 with clock face at y≈60.

Arch entrance on front side (z=+14 face) of building; front is +z.

Bridge: from island right edge x=44 out to right, at y=10, spanning x[44,74], with arches (negative space) → negative space under bridge arches.

Dock: at right end x[74,92], z[-14,14] small wooden dock with pilings.

Floating cloud islands: above and around, e.g., at (60, 60, 30), etc. Use cloud style.

Copper mechanical details: gears on tower, copper pipes, weathervane, brass bands.

Glowing windows: mf:lamp style windows.

Let me write code carefully with deterministic loops.

Total boxes budget ~5000. Use big boxes for mass, avoid per-voxel.

Let me structure code:

```js
const S={stone:'stone',...}
```

Use style uid strings from catalog: 'stone','wood','blue','grass','soil','sand','snow','brick','concrete','steel','gold','copper','lamp','neon','lava','water','glass','ice','cloud','storm','leaves','smoke','wool','rubber'. Catalog uid like "mf:stone". Hint says "Styles are catalog IDs/UID names" so both 'stone' or 'mf:stone' fine. I'll use 'mf:stone' explicit.

Batch 1: island + building mass. Then capture. Then refine.

Let me be careful about the API: mf.box(min,[w,h,d],{style,tint,motion}). mf.wall(origin,w,h,{thickness,style}) — wall in which plane? Probably x-y wall with thickness in z. mf.roof(origin,w,d,h,{style}) — pyramid-ish roof. I'll mostly use explicit boxes for control.

Group usage: mf.group('island', ()=>{ ... }).

Stage 1 code:

```js
// island
mf.group('island', ()=>{
  // main island layers tapering downward (floating rock)
  const H=12;
  for(let y=0;y<H;y++){
    const t = y/(H-1);
    // shrink with depth: use stepped widths
    const w = 8 + Math.round(76*t*0.9); // half? 
  }
});
```

Simpler: define layers array with half-extents:
levels y=0..9: halfX from 12→44, halfZ from 8→32.
y=10: grass top plate.

Actually put island top at y=10: rock from y=0..9, grass at y=10 (thin plate 1 tall covering full), then building base from y=11.

Let's do: for y=0..9: k=(y+1)/10; hx=Math.round(13+31*k) → y=9: 41... then grass cap at y=10 hx=44 (halfX). Hmm need island extents x[-44,44] → halfX 44 means w=89. Let's define island as x from -44 to 44 inclusive width 89. Fine, use explicit.

I'll write helper: function layer(y, hx, hz, style) → mf.box([-hx,y,-hz],[2*hx+1,1,2*hz+1],{style}).

Island rock: y=0: hx=16,hz=10; increase up to y=9: hx=42,hz=30. At y=10 grass plate hx=44,hz=32 with grass; also stone rim.

Also snow? No, stone/grass.

Water? Maybe small pond — skip; keep focus.

Building:
- footprint: x[-30,10] (width 41), z[-22,14] (depth 37). Base walls stone from y=11 to y=40.
- Build hollow walls (4 boxes) plus floor and cornice. Interior empty (negative space).
- Wall thickness 3.
- Blue roof: layered pitched roof above y=41 with stepped slabs narrowing upward to ridge along x. Let's do steep hip roof: for i=0..9: inset i, height step 2; boxes covering.

Simpler roof: for i=0..11: layer y=41+i*2 .. shape box inset i*2 in z, inset i in x, blue. Ridge at x from -18 to -2? Let's compute: footprint x[-30,10], z[-22,14]. Roof layers: i-th: z inset = i*1.8 → use Math.round. Let's use i from 0..10, z0=-22+i*2, z1=14-i*2, x0=-31+i, x1=11-i. When z0>z1 stop (i>9). Height per layer 2 → rise 20. Roof from y=41 to 60. Tower up to 76, good, tower taller.

Actually roof sloping along z only (gable along x) — fine, "屋顶层次" layered. Add a second smaller roof/dormer? Add dormer boxes and eaves trim with copper.

Tower: footprint x[-42,-26] (w 17), z[-20,-4] (d 17). Height from y=11 to y=72. Stone shaft, top belfry with arches, copper belt bands, clock face on +z and +x? Front is +z, so clock on z=-4 face? Since building is behind (z from -22 to 14), tower z=-20..-4 is inside building footprint? Building x[-30,10]; tower x[-42,-26] overlaps x[-30,-26]. Slight overlap — make tower x[-44,-30] to attach at left wall, z[-22,-4]... but island extends to x=-44. OK tower x[-44,-30] (w 15) touching building left wall at x=-30. Hmm island edge x=-44, tower outer at -44 exactly on edge. Let's shift: tower x[-42,-28] overlapping building by 2. Fine, overlap ok (rooms merge).

Actually cleaner: tower x[-44,-30] full 15 wide, z[-20,-6] 15 deep, and island halfX=46 to give margin. Let's set island x[-48,48]? Then bridge starts at x=48. Fine, make island halfX 48, halfZ 34. Ground top plates large. Building shifted: keep building x[-30,10].

Hmm, east side of island has lots of empty space x[10,48] — could put garden/plaza with copper machine details. Good: a copper orrery / gears in plaza at right, plus small crates. Actually dock is right, connected by bridge from island right edge. Plaza on right top is fine.

Clock face: on tower's +z face at z=-6 (front face toward +z... wait tower z range [-20,-6]; the +z face is z=-6, facing the building interior? Building occupies z[-22,14] which includes -6..14, so tower's +z face is inside building. Hmm. Tower attached at building's left, front should be z=14 face of building for arch entrance. Tower front face should be +z = -6 which is buried inside building. Bad.

Better: make tower attached at front-left corner, protruding forward: tower z[-20,4] and building z[-22,14]... still buried.

Alternative: tower at front-left outside building: tower x[-46,-32], z[6,20]? Then front face z=20 visible ahead of building front z=14. But island halfZ=34 → ok within.

Let me re-plan layout with front = +z:

- Building: x[-30,10] (w41), z[-20,12] (d33). Front wall at z=12.
- Tower: attached at left front: x[-46,-32], z[-4,10]; front face z=10 roughly aligned. Hmm clock needs to be visible from front. Put tower in front-left corner protruding: x[-46,-32], z[0,14] so its front face z=14 sticks out 2 beyond building front. Its clock at z=14 face, y around 55-65. Good, visible from front. And tower touches building left wall x=-30? tower max x = -32, building min x=-30 → gap of 1 (x=-31). Make tower x[-45,-31] w=15, then gap 0 at x=-31..-30? building min=-30, tower max=-31 → adjacent, so no gap. Good.

Island: x[-52,52] halfX 52 → need tower at -45 within. z[-34,34].

Bridge right: from x=52 to x=80 at y=10 (top of island). Dock at x[80,96], z[-16,16]. VRC limit X<128 ok.

Bridge with negative space: arches under deck: deck slab y=10..13, piers/arch spandrels with gaps. Build arches: for each arch span, place curve boxes.

Floating cloud islands: e.g., center at (70,80,40) etc. Use slate? Use cloud style with stone bottom. Keep them clear of main tower (tower up to y~78 at x -45..-31). Place cloud islands at x 30..90, y 60..110, z -60..-20 and one at upper left.

Also add tiny "messenger" details: copper pipes, antenna with lamp.

Let me write stage 1: island + building + tower basic + roof + bridge + dock mass. Then capture, fix, add details.

Given budget, code must be manageable. Let me write it.

Stage 1 code:

```js
const P=(m)=>m;
// ---- island ----
mf.group('island',()=>{
  // rock underside tapered
  for(let y=0;y<10;y++){
    const k=(y+1)/10;
    const hx=Math.round(18+30*k), hz=Math.round(10+22*k);
    mf.box([-hx,y,-hz],[hx*2+1,1,hz*2+1],{style:'mf:stone'});
  }
  // top soil ring + grass
  mf.box([-52,9,-34],[105,1,69],{style:'mf:soil'});
  mf.box([-52,10,-34],[105,1,69],{style:'mf:grass'});
  ...
});
```
Wait rock layers at y=9 shaped; y=9 box would overwrite? Order: later boxes paint over. Actually rock at y=9 hx=48,hz=32; then soil y=9 hx 52 overwrites partially. Simpler: rock y=0..8, soil y=9, grass y=10, top y=10. Building base y=11.

Hmm grass top plate 105x69 = big single box fine.

Stone rim edge: skip or add at y=10 border ring boxes (4 boxes).

Building: base y=11.

```js
mf.group('building',()=>{
  // floor plate
  mf.box([-30,11,-20],[41,2,33],{style:'mf:concrete'});
  // walls stone, height 30 -> y13..42
  const w=41,d=33,x0=-30,z0=-20,h=30;
  mf.box([x0,13,z0],[w,h,3],{style:'mf:stone'}); // back wall z0..z0+2
  mf.box([x0,13,z0+d-3],[w,h,3],{style:'mf:stone'}); // front wall
  mf.box([x0,13,z0],[3,h,d],{style:'mf:stone'});
  mf.box([x0+w-3,13,z0],[3,h,d],{style:'stone'});
```

body.instructions:
你是 MorphForge 体素艺术创作助手，负责在当前工程中连续创作清晰、可检查、可保存的作品。VRC 是可选发布目标；不要把它当作所有作品的边界。

工作流程：
1. 每轮先调用 `get_context`，确认权威 revision、工程范围、目标能力和可用材质。材质目录会分页；只选择返回的材质 ID 或 UID。
2. 先搭建大形和负空间，再补细节。使用 `run_recipe` 的 JavaScript 函数和循环批量创建，不要逐盒调用工具。
3. 对文字优先调用 `voxel_text` 预览布局；只有请求仍与预览一致时才应用。应用前检查 `baseRevision`，并传稳定 `requestId`。
4. 大形完成或有明显变化后，用 `capture_views` 查看 hero/front/top。根据真实渲染修正轮廓、比例、接地和材质统一；不要每创建一个 Box 就截图。
5. 完成后读取 revision/stats，多视角复核并保存作品。只有用户明确要求或自动发布已启用时才 publish。

状态与安全：
- 新作品可用 `replace`；在现有作品上继续用 `apply`。每次写入都使用 `get_context` 返回的准确 `baseRevision`。遇到 revision conflict 后先重新读取上下文。
- `steer` 插话会在当前完整工具批次结束后进入下一模型请求；排队消息在当前助手轮次完成后进入下一轮；`interrupt` 会取消当前未完成请求并用新指令续接。空文本 interrupt 表示暂停。取消前已完成的修改仍保留，未完成工具不会提交。
- 用户明确要求停止时停止当前 run。暂停后继续工作前先读取最新上下文。不要假定已接受的消息等于已应用；以事件中的 applied 状态为准。
- 工具失败时解释具体原因并调整请求，不重复执行有副作用的工具。未经用户要求不要自动发布。
- 约 5,000 Box 是完整作品的实用基准，16,384 是压力目标；不要为凑数量增加无意义细节。共享材质与连续盒合并有助于降低开销。
- 艺术空间可超出 VRChat 坐标范围。只有目标明确为 VRChat 时才要求 X/Z 在 `[-128,128)`、Y 在 `[0,256)`。
- 真实远端 ACK、上传结果和其他玩家可见状态不能由本机发送状态推断。未收到可靠证据时明确说明。

工具职责：`get_context` 读取权威状态；`run_recipe` 执行确定性几何操作；`voxel_text` 列字体、预览或应用文本 Box；`inspect_region` 读取局部摘要；`capture_views` 检查渲染；`commit` 保存已检查版本；`publish` 进入可选的异步 VRC 队列；`sync_status` 查询本机队列；`artworks` 保存或恢复作品；`undo_to` 创建历史恢复版本；`compact_context` 只整理模型上下文，不删除原始日志和作品。

content.text:
Now the clock works — visible round dial. Good. Arch entrance visible with copper frame. Island octagon better.

Remaining issues visible:
1. Clock dial: appears mostly dark with copper hands; the bezel ring appears copper but the dial face is dark and hands white? Looks okay but a bit mushy. Could brighten: make dial snow/white with rubber numerals. Actually looks like a big pocket watch. Let's make dial face light (snow) and hands copper/rubber for contrast. Currently dark dial with copper bezel: reads as a clock? From the render it looks like a round dark disc with copper ring. Improve: dial face = mf:snow (light), rim = copper, hands = rubber (dark) for contrast. That's a clear fix (paint at z=15 to recolor existing dial boxes).

2. The building front: window glass appears as small yellow dots (lamp glowing) but glass panes rarely visible. Windows too small/sparse. Make windows bigger: 4x6 with copper frame and lamp core. Increase readability.

3. Roof: reads well, blue stepped. Good.

4. Bridge: the deck reads as wood/brown with copper arches below; from front view the arches are white/grey (stone piers) with copper webs. Looks decent. But the bridge's arch negative space: mostly the piers dominate. Acceptable.

5. Dock: acceptable, hut roof tiny blue pyramid on wooden deck with pilings. The dock seems to float, pilings go down to -14. It reads like a wooden platform with 6 legs. Reasonable.

6. The dock appears in front-left of the bridge in hero (fine).

7. Missing: the tower's clock reads; tower's blue roof is a stepped pyramid; the spire copper block + gold vane tiny.

8. Composition issue: main island is very flat/wide, the building sits with big empty green to the right and back. Plaza props help. But the top view shows a big rectangular sand path crossing vertically (the [10,10,-5,44,12] path and [-16,10,30,20,5])—there's an odd long sand stripe going through the island at z... The top view shows a vertical sand band from the bridge to the building — that's the path. Fine.

9. In top view I notice the sand plaza sits over the building? no.

10. Island silhouette still quite rectangular in top view except corners chamfered — the chamfer only appears at corners? Top view shows rounded-ish corners. OK.

11. Front view: the tower's clock is on the right side of the tower, partially overlapped by the building roof? Looks fine at y=36 (below tower belt at 42).

12. One noticeable issue: building's front wall face is barely lit; windows tiny. Increase.

13. Also the entrance: door brown, arch copper frame reads nicer now. 

14. Cloud islands: still pancakes; the rock underside appears as small tapered stack (white). Add darker soil band to read as rock, e.g., paint bottom layers soil. And add a couple more cloud lumps offset for puffiness. Minor improvement.

15. The building looks like it has no roof overhang at the sides — the roof starts inset by 1? It reads fine.

16. Consider adding: a small balcony? Not necessary.

Let me do a final polish pass:
a) clock: light dial + dark hands + copper bezel (paint z=15 dial to snow, hands at z=16 to rubber + gold center).
b) windows: enlarge front windows to 4 wide x 6 tall with copper frame + glass + lamp; also add side windows.
c) cloud islands: add soil tone to rock underside via paint, plus extra cloud lumps.
d) Some stone buttresses/arches on building sides to break the flat wall: add 2 pilasters on the front face and a string course. Also maybe add arched windows on the front (2 tall arches) for the "驿站" character.
e) Tower: add a second clock on the -x side? Not needed.
f) Add slight asymmetric roof detail: dormers.

Actually careful with time/complexity. Do the key improvements: clock contrast, window size/readability, cloud island rock tone + puffs, building wall pilasters + arched windows. Then final capture, commit, save.

Windows enlargement: front wall z 10..12, outer face z=12; y rows 13..42. Currently windows at y=29..33 and 36..39, x -27,-22,2,7 (3 wide). Let's convert to arched windows 4 wide, 8 tall: y=28..36 with arch top. I'll paint glass on z=12 region, add copper frames at z=13 (protruding), lamp core.

Since paint only recolors, painting a 4x6 at z=12 within the wall works (wall exists there).

New window set: at x = -28, -22, 2, 8? Building x -30..9; keep it at -28,-22,2,7 (width 4 → -28..-25). Between windows plenty.

Design: for each wx: 
- paint([wx,28,12],[4,8,1], GL)
- paint([wx+1,29,12],[2,6,1],'mf:lamp')? Too much glow — "少量发光窗". Use lamp 1x2 core: paint([wx+1,30,12],[2,3,1],LA)? Let's do lamp core 1 wide: paint([wx+1,30,12],[1,3,1],LA) and window glass rest.
- copper frame at z=13: B(wx-1,27,13,6,1,1,CU) sill; B(wx-1,28,13,1,9,1,CU) left; B(wx+4,28,13,1,9,1,CU) right; arch top: B(wx,37,13,4,1,1,CU); B(wx+1,38,13,2,1,1,CU).

That's 5 boxes × 4 windows = 20 + paints. Fine. Need to remove old windows/sills: the old sill boxes at y=28 z=13 remain from previous stage (B(wx-1,28,13,5,1,1,CU)) — new frames overlap, fine.

Old glass paints at y=36..38 z=12 x 3 wide remain, and new window covers y 28..37 so ok; residual glass at y=38 x 3 wide is within new arch region? new glass 28..35 (height 8 → 28..35), arch 36..38. Hmm residual old glass at 36..38 would show glass where arch stone should be. Let me paint over: paint([wx-1,36,12],[6,3,1],ST) to restore stone, then paint new glass.

Simpler: for each window: paint region x wx-2..wx+5, y 26..40 at z=12 with STONE (reset), then paint glass 28..35 and lamp; then copper frames. Let's do that.

Also side wall windows (x=10): enlarge: paint([10,28,wz],[1,8,4],ST) reset then glass 6 tall etc. Keep simple: add copper frames.

Cloud islands: paint rock underside to soil for contrast: for each isle, paint region below cy (cy-5..cy-1) → mf.paint([cx-r-1,cy-5,cz-r],[2r+3,5,2r+2],{style:SO}) but paint only recolors existing → only rock voxels. Good.

Also add puff lumps: B(cx-r*0.9, cy+2, cz+r*0.4, ...) etc. Add 2 boxes each.

Building wall: add pilasters (buttresses) at front corners and 2 mid: B(-32? ) Let's add at x=-31,-24,-1? Actually decorative: vertical stone pilasters at front face z=13 protruding: at x=-29 (corner), x=-2? and a string course at y=25 already? Add copper string course at y=26 (like belts at 40). Hmm there's already belts at 40.

Add: horizontal stone course at y=26: paint z: B(-31,26,-21,43,1,35,SA)? That would add a stone band wrapping exterior. Actually a protruding belt: B(-32,26,-22,45,1,37,SA) - it would cover windows at y=29? no, 26 fine. But it will overlap wall. OK adds readability.

Let's also add arched blind niches on the right part of front wall? skip.

Also: add stairs/terrace: small stone terrace at entrance already.

Let's finalize polish code, then capture, commit, save to gallery.

Also details: add hanging banner on tower front: B(-45,20,15,...)? Banner: blue cloth on tower front between y=20..26 x -44..-33 at z=15? that's where pipes are. Skip.

One more important item: "屋顶层次" satisfied by stepped roof. Add small dormer windows on roof front slope to enhance layering: place at x=-24,-14,0: roof slope front edge z=-20+2i at y=43+2i. Dormers: at x, y=47 base, small box protruding forward. Roof at y=45 (i=1) front edge z=-18. A dormer at y=46..50 sticking out to z=-16. Complicated; skip.

Let me write polish.
钟面现在清晰可见，拱门和铜框也读得出来。再做一轮收尾修正：**钟面对比度、窗户太小、云岛像薄饼、墙面过平**。

input.content: 请制作完整的体素艺术作品《云港信使驿站》。要有能一眼认出的主建筑剪影、带可见钟面的钟楼、拱形入口、铜色机械细节、屋顶层次、悬空云岛、右侧小码头和一条有负空间的连接桥。采用蓝色屋顶、暖铜、浅色石材、少量发光窗；分组名分别为 island、building、tower、bridge、dock、details，便于后续继续。目标可发布VRChat，X/Z在[-128,128)、Y在[0,256)；合理利用长方体，不用为凑数量堆重复体素。先搭大形并保存进度，hero/front/top截图检查后至少修正一轮（务必实际修改，不只口头评价），再次截图复核。控制每阶段推理和代码长度，优先完成可交付作品。最终commit并保存到作品库。不要启用或发布OSC，暂不需要文字。用中文说明完成情况。

tools.description: 读取权威 revision、工程限制、目标能力、固定要求和一页可用材质。
tools.name: get_context

tools.description: 把确定性 JavaScript 体素几何作为一个事务执行。用紧凑函数和循环；apply 用于续作，replace 仅用于新场景，并传准确 baseRevision。
tools.name: run_recipe

tools.description: 读取局部区域或分组摘要，不返回完整 Box 数组。
tools.name: inspect_region

tools.description: 对指定 revision 捕获固定视角的真实渲染，用于检查作品。
tools.name: capture_views

tools.description: 提交已检查的草稿 revision。
tools.name: commit

tools.description: 把已提交 revision 放入可选的异步 VRChat 发布队列。
tools.name: publish

tools.description: 读取本机发送进度；本机发送不等于远端 ACK。
tools.name: sync_status

tools.description: 把历史 revision 恢复为新的草稿 revision。
tools.name: undo_to

tools.description: 搜索、保存、载入或分支作品。
tools.name: artworks

tools.description: 在完整工具批次后整理模型上下文；保留原始日志、源 artifact 和作品。
tools.name: compact_context

tools.description: 列字体、预览或应用体素文字。应用前检查预览与当前请求一致，并传受保护的 baseRevision 和 requestId；材质使用 get_context 返回的 ID。
tools.name: voxel_text

data.message: 钟面现在清晰可见，拱门和铜框也读得出来。再做一轮收尾修正：**钟面对比度、窗户太小、云岛像薄饼、墙面过平**。
data.prompt: 请制作完整的体素艺术作品《云港信使驿站》。要有能一眼认出的主建筑剪影、带可见钟面的钟楼、拱形入口、铜色机械细节、屋顶层次、悬空云岛、右侧小码头和一条有负空间的连接桥。采用蓝色屋顶、暖铜、浅色石材、少量发光窗；分组名分别为 island、building、tower、bridge、dock、details，便于后续继续。目标可发布VRChat，X/Z在[-128,128)、Y在[0,256)；合理利用长方体，不用为凑数量堆重复体素。先搭大形并保存进度，hero/front/top截图检查后至少修正一轮（务必实际修改，不只口头评价），再次截图复核。控制每阶段推理和代码长度，优先完成可交付作品。最终commit并保存到作品库。不要启用或发布OSC，暂不需要文字。用中文说明完成情况。
